reason: This is not a published or data-qualified chapter and not an adoption approval. Shared qualification now independently revalidates each retained dossier proof against current primary units and person-dependency fingerprints, reconstructs facts only from scoped validated members, keeps source/date/editorial/family gates, and stamps reviewed uncertainty onto catalog/ebook HTML. Compact constraint replay measured equivalent to prior membership/lineage with generatedPairs 0; Jinshu 053 72/73 native proof is a sealed review receipt, not a live site. Mention-span witnesses accept validated abbreviations/kinship (衍長女/長女) and still reject unrelated Han (美, 字) and invented people. Changes are required before calling the candidate CI/presentation-complete: the compiler's own self-test still demands pair-era catalog fields/candidate writers, and person-page JSON-LD/search/lede omit the uncertainty the HTML note is supposed to enforce. Remaining listed work (CI fixture migration, registry builder, scheduler automation, deployment, selective proof reuse after edits) stays unfinished and must not be counted as a green release.
